summary.text: Michiel Montiel is the Democratic candidate for Arizona State Senate District 7 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Wendy Rogers.
According to Ballotpedia, he served in the U.S. Army from 2001 to 2005.

paragraphs.text: Montiel graduated from Superior High School, earned an associate degree from Mesa Community College and a bachelor's degree from Arizona State University, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Montiel described himself as a fourth-generation Arizonan, Army combat veteran and lifelong resident of rural Arizona who has spent years building local organizations and supporting veterans.
He listed affordability, healthcare and education among his campaign messages.
